PESHAWAR HIGH COURT BENCHES AREA OF JURISDICTION RULES, 1981
PESHAWAR HIGH COURT BENCHES AREA OF JURISDICTION
RULES, 1981
[Gazette of N: W. F. P., Extraordinary, 19th May, 1981]
No. SOC (S & GAD) 26/1‑81/4732.‑In
pursuance of clause (6) of Article 7 of the Provisional Constitution Order,
1981, the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province, in consultation
with the Chief Justice of the Peshawar High Court, is pleased to make the
following rules, namely
1.‑(1) These rules may be called the Peshawar High
Court Benches Area of Jurisdiction Rules, 1981.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. The High Court Bench at Abbottabad shall exercise the
jurisdiction vested in the High Court, in respect of cases relating to the
Civil Division of Hazara.
3. The High Court Bench at Dera Ismail .Khan shall
exercise the jurisdiction vested in the High Court, in respect of cases
relating to the Civil Division of Dera Ismail Khan.
4. All such cases as are referred to in rule 2 and rule s,
pending in the High Court immediately before the commencement of these rules,
shall stand transferred to the respective benches for disposal.
5. There shall be established registry of the High Court,
each at Abbottabad and Dera Ismail Khan to receive on behalf of the respective
High Court Bench such cases as are referred to in rule 2 and rule 3.
6. Each registry established at Abbottabad and Dera Ismail
Khan shall be beaded by an Additional Registrar who may be appointed by name or
by virtue of office, and consist of such other staff as the Chief. Justice may
appoint.
7. The Chief Justice of the Peshawar High Court may, from
time to time, by order delegate all or any of his powers and functions to any
Judge and may in like. manner withdraw all or any of such powers and functions.
